verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API access through OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible SDKs and a first-call guide. However, no item describes self-serve signup, creating or minting an API key, or the absence of a sales or waitlist gate. Rate-limit and capacity-expansion pages cover a related topic but not key onboarding, so the axis applies with no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign up and mint an API key self-serve — no sales call, no waitlist gymnastics — and the docs say exactly how
